definitions.gloss: short-neck clam, Manila clam, littleneck clam
definitions.explanation: A small bivalve commonly used in Japanese cooking, typically in miso soup, pasta, and sake-steamed dishes.

examples.japanese: アサリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
アサリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧アサリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I collected a lot of clams while clamming at low tide.

notes:
Usually written in katakana; the kanji {浅蜊|あさり} is rare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アサリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: clam miso soup
- アサリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒蒸|さかむ}し: clams steamed in sake
- アサリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{砂抜|すなぬ}き: soaking clams in salt water so they spit out sand

CULTURAL NOTE: ⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧ (digging for clams at low tide) is a popular spring outing, and アサリ are the clams people usually find.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {蛤|はまぐり}: hard clam — larger and pricier, served on festive occasions
